newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends mostly lower in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends mostly lower in thin trade.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended mostly lower in thin trade ahead of Tuesday's expiry of the May contract, traders said.
"It's just routine evening up trade ahead of expiry," one pit source said. "We're converging with cash."
The May contract led old crop months down but floor sources noted open interest was at 18 lots as of Friday's close, down 26 lots from the previous session.
"There's nothing in there," a trader said.
Trade sources said the market was looking for direction from Monday's USDA weekly crop progress report.
Traders said they expected it to show the crop continued to lag average development pace.
"Today's crop report is going to be important and it should give us some direction," a trader said.
Rice ended six cents per cwt lower to unchanged with July off one at $11.46. Volume was estimated by CBOT at 200 lots, compared with Friday's actual volume of 664 lots.
